title: Tesseract 4D
description: Tesseract in four spatial coordinates, projected to a 3D scene.
detail: Tesseract in four spatial coordinates, projected to a 3D scene. · t is elapsed time. w is an independent spatial coordinate. · Set each speed to zero to hold its plane angle. Angles are in radians. · The half-side in 4D is 1. Keep the 4D eye distance above sqrt(2). · xyz radius and w radius set the display thickness of the projected edges. · Eight edges vary only in x. · Eight edges vary only in y. · Eight edges vary only in z. · Eight edges vary only in w. · Rotate each endpoint in two independent planes.
